# Ymer & Vesence


We are proud to welcome Ymer as a Vesence customer.


Founded in 2017, Ymer is a Swedish alternative credit manager that gives Nordic investors access to global structured credit markets.


## About Ymer


Ymer launched the first structured credit fund in Sweden in 2018. Its funds invest across structured credit, including collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and synthetic CDOs, aiming to capture the premia that illiquidity and complexity create.


In 2025, Ymer launched its fourth fund, the Ymer European Structured Credit Fund IV, listed on the Nordic Growth Market.
